youtube_description:
If you have a specific question for Steve he can be reached at stevenkkline@gmail.com.

The Centreville Town Council Election is Monday, October 5. Polls are open from 7am to 7pm at the County Building located at 110 Vincit St. in Centreville, MD.

All candidates who appeared in this video series were asked the same questions and were given the same amount of time to respond.  All questions were picked Angela Price of the Bay Times/Record Observer and were based on suggestions from the public.
